# MechanicsKit API Reference

This section provides a detailed reference for the `MechanicsKit` library API.

## Core Components

-   [**LaTeX Display**](latex_display.qmd): Functions for rendering NumPy and SymPy objects as LaTeX.
-   [**Mesh**](mesh.qmd): The `Mesh` class for 1-based FEM data structures.
-   [**OneArray**](onearray.qmd): A 1-based array wrapper for NumPy arrays.
-   [**Plotting**](plotting.qmd): High-level plotting functions `patch` and `fplot`.
-   [**Colormaps**](colormaps.qmd): Utilities for working with colormaps.
